results.body:
incorrect request matcher json format for:

  {
      "path": "somePath",
      "extra_field": "extra_value"
  }

 schema validation errors:

  6 errors:
   - $.anyOf: is missing but it is required
   - $.binaryData: is missing but it is required
   - $.dnsName: is missing but it is required
   - $.extra_field: is not defined in the schema and the schema does not allow additional properties
   - $.if: is missing but it is required
   - $.specUrlOrPayload: is missing, but is required, if specifying OpenAPI request matcher
  
  OpenAPI Specification: https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/jamesdbloom/mock-server-openapi/9.2.x
  Documentation: https://mock-server.com/mock_server/creating_expectations.html
